Mum: Where are the towels, please?
Dad: They are in the cupboard next to the sink.

Ben: What is beside your bed?
Anna: My wardrobe is beside it.

Dad: I am tired. I will sit down now.
Mum: The sofa is free.

Ben: There are some flowers by the gate.
